propositions: A new advisory-mode code-review overlay (surface-parity) must flag when a write-op parameter, guard, or required-field surface changes in one adapter (_lib_writes.py, _commands/, _mcp_writes.py) without corresponding updates in sibling adapters.

The overlay fires via glob routing on diffs touching the three write-surface adapter files and remains inert on unrelated diffs, routed through existing GLOB-triggered overlay infrastructure without changes to registry.content_triggered_overlays.
The overlay is wired into the four-pass gate round_a and round_b batches so the finder is actually dispatched, not merely an unused flag.
The base-reviewer catalog in code-review-base.md must list surface-parity to satisfy the strict no-drift test requiring exact parity with OVERLAY_IDS.

The reviewer prompt carries false-positive guards (deliberate justified divergence, internal-only refactors, adapter-bound non-caller-visible params like _creation_channel/source/repo_root) to prevent spurious findings.
